effect.shortEffect: Status moves go last, but are not affected by the opponent's ability.
effect.full: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

french.sv: Le Pokémon agit toujours plus lentement quand il utilise\nune capacité de statut, mais il ignore les talents adverses.

english.sv: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

japanese.sv: 変化技を　出すとき 必ず　行動が　遅くなるが 相手の　特性に　ジャマされない。
